nodes.title: Periodized Gaussian field
nodes.statement: Centered, variance-one stationary Gaussian field on the flat d-torus.
nodes.scope: Fixed d ≥ 2 and side L > 0; the exact periodized model, not the minimum-image approximation.

nodes.title: Conditioned two-pin weighted law
nodes.statement: The pin observations and the full determinant tilt used in D1 and its dependent counting results.
nodes.scope: Unit axial vector u; b in compact birth interval, k in a compact positive-gap interval, and original full normalizer.

nodes.title: Uniform global elder selection
nodes.statement: Under the conditioned and tilted law, the chance that the specified saddle is not the maximum’s global elder partner is bounded by a cubic term.
nodes.scope: Uniform over compact birth and strictly positive gap-mark intervals and all orthonormal frames; sufficiently small r and reading-rule corrections apply.

nodes.title: Compact-mark lifetime density
nodes.statement: Candidate maximum–saddle pairs and actual elder pairs have a shared leading short-lifetime density. Their difference is quantitatively smaller.
nodes.scope: B,K must be compact intervals of positive length, with K bounded away from zero; restricted pair distance; fixed d,L.

nodes.title: Unrestricted finite-bar leading term
nodes.statement: For the specified fixed periodized field, the full candidate-pair and actual finite superlevel H₀ lifetime densities have the same leading power.
equations:
ν_cand^all(ℓ) ∼ c_{d,L} ℓ^(−1/3)
ν_eld^all(ℓ) ∼ c_{d,L} ℓ^(−1/3),  0<c_{d,L}<∞
nodes.scope: All births, positive gap marks, orientations and spatial separations at fixed d,L. Essential global maximum class excluded. The compact-window difference rate is NOT imported.

nodes.title: Positive Fourier spectrum and finite-jet nondegeneracy
nodes.statement: Every lattice frequency has strictly positive Fourier weight; distinct finite-jet evaluation functionals have nondegenerate Gaussian covariance.
equations:
K_L(z)=Σ_{n∈ℤᵈ} a_n exp(2πi n·z/L)
a_n=exp(−2π²|n|²/L²) / Σ_j exp(−2π²|j|²/L²) > 0
nodes.scope: The precise periodized covariance and nonduplicate symmetric-jet coordinates.

local_checks.limits: Spectral formula and jet positivity derived using standard Poisson summation/Fourier uniqueness.

nodes.title: Contact-frame Jacobian
nodes.statement: The exact transformed two-pin observations have an invertible matrix and a specified determinant.
nodes.scope: The original axial and transverse observation ordering; r>0.

nodes.title: Bounded unrestricted lifetime remainder
nodes.statement: The project’s accepted scoped refinement bounds the deviations of unrestricted candidate and actual elder densities from the leading power term.
equations:
|ν_cand(ℓ)−c ℓ^(−1/3)| ≤ C
0 ≤ ν_cand(ℓ)−ν_eld(ℓ) ≤ C
|ν_eld(ℓ)−c ℓ^(−1/3)| ≤ C
nodes.scope: For sufficiently small ℓ in the exact fixed d,L field, using the parent theorem interfaces. C and lifetime cutoff are existential; no second coefficient.

local_checks.limits: The full-mark ell exponents and cutoff integration checked assuming R11/R12, cap selection, Kac-Rice and far-region bounds; full theorem not independently reproved. Reinspected cap/matrix imports in v11; global theorem not certified.

Ψ_F ≥ C(f)
Q_r(Ψ_F>x), Qʷ_r(Ψ_F>x) ≤ C exp(−c x^(2/d))  for x≥1

nodes.title: Stretched-exponential moment

nodes.scope: Fixed d and parameter regime of C6-F; some a>0.

nodes.title: Rare-count ordinary-Poisson obstruction
nodes.statement: A project-reviewed conditional implication from count upper bounds and multiple-occurrence lower bounds: ordinary Poisson approximation cannot beat cubic total-variation error.
nodes.scope: Abstract assumptions H1: EN<=A r^3 and H2: P(N>=2)>=a r^3, with a,A>0; original Gaussian application needs the accepted D5 and sharp C6 inputs. Not a positive Poisson limit claim.

nodes.statement: Project-reviewed conditional result for the actual r-dependent positive-count law F and p=P(N>0).
nodes.scope: H1 and H2; F=Law(N | N>0) is generally unknown and depends on r. This does not identify a limiting cluster distribution or an in-field spatial clustering process.

nodes.title: Independent-replica subsequential compound-Poisson law
nodes.statement: A reviewed theorem for pooling independent copies of an entire pinned count, along convergent rare-intensity subsequences.
nodes.scope: H1,H2 and every fixed factorial Hq; subsequence with nu_r -> nu, and m_r=floor(t/r^3) independent whole-field replicas; NOT independent spatial cells in one realization; no unique limit asserted.

nodes.title: All-height fixed-annulus critical-point bound
nodes.statement: A project-reviewed upper bound controls the weighted first moment of critical points of each index in any Borel subset of a fixed, scaled planar annulus.

nodes.scope: Fixed planar d=2 and L; 1<A<B<infinity FIXED; compact birth and positive-gap marks k>=k_->0; original six conditioned pins and determinant tilt; j=0,1,2; all heights. No uniform-in-L, higher-d, pin, mesoscopic, growing-annulus, collision or numerical claim.
